text.en: Participants praise Sarah and Sam for their deep understanding of canine behaviour and their clear, friendly coaching. Reviewers appreciate that the trainers demonstrate techniques step-by-step and offer constructive feedback until handlers get exercises right. Pet owners note the warm, encouraging atmosphere throughout class sessions.

Owners report quick progress in puppy manners, leash walking, and core focus commands after completing class exercises. Reviewers highlight that training routines are easy to practice at home and yield tangible behavioural results. Clients express confidence in managing real-world situations with their developing dogs following the courses.

Reviewers emphasize the positive, low-stress methods used during group puppy classes and private home sessions. The trainers focus on building confidence and healthy socialisation without using harsh or intimidating methods. Pet parents note that their puppies genuinely enjoy class activities and interact happily with trainers and peers.

q.en: What formats of training does The CanoCoach offer?

a.en: The service provides structured puppy foundation group classes as well as one-to-one home training sessions.

q.en: Are training notes provided after class sessions?

a.en: Yes, participants mention receiving helpful written notes to guide their home practice between weekly lessons.

q.en: What training methodology is applied during courses?

a.en: Trainers use reward-based, positive reinforcement methods focused on building focus, life skills, and canine confidence.

q.en: At what age can puppies join the foundation courses?

a.en: Reviewers typically enrol young puppies around 12 to 16 weeks of age after initial vaccinations are complete.
